subject: Okta subscription sunset, migration & evidence sprint
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@okta.com>, okta-sales-ops@okta.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Okta subscription sunset, migration & evidence sprint

Sarah / Okta team —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. We need to lock a short, focused plan to: (1) finish the SOC2 / device-posture evidence handoff, (2) agree the SOW amendment for the adaptive auth pilot, and (3) finalize PO timing so we don’t face the October price-band change. High level asks from our side:

- Evidence sprint window: prefer Sep 16–19 (three half-day sessions) to turn over controls artifacts and confirm acceptance criteria.
- SOW amendment: we need the draft by Sep 9 so Legal can review ahead of the sprint.
- PO timing: to secure current pricing we need the PO issued by Sep 26 (30 days before contract anniversary). If that date isn’t feasible, please confirm what pricing window we’ll fall into.

Two constraints to flag: our security team requires a device-posture attestation (firm list of signals) before we can enable the pilot in prod; and Finance wants a one-off overlap credit to cover the three-week parallel period while we migrate.

I’m copying Marissa (security/compliance), Karthik (procurement/finance) and Vivek (platform) — please assign owners on your side for each artifact. I’ve attached an evidence index template we’ll use to collect items.

Next steps: please confirm the SOW delivery date and whether you can run the evidence sessions in the proposed window.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Procurement (contracting lead)
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0183

Attachments: redwood-evidence-index.xlsx
From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@okta.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: okta-sales-ops@okta.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Okta subscription sunset, migration & evidence sprint

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks — we can support that cadence. Quick responses inline: 

- SOW amendment: we’ll get a first-pass SOW amendment to you by EOD Sep 8 (our legal team will mark up scope for the adaptive auth pilot and device-posture acceptance criteria).
- Evidence sprint: Sep 16–18 works for our engineering/compliance SMEs (we can do 3 x 90-min sessions; if helpful we’ll record and produce action items).
- PO timing / pricing: we can confirm that a PO issued by Sep 26 will lock current pricing. If PO slips beyond Sep 26, there’s a published SKU band change on Oct 1 which would increase unit rates by ~7%.

Regarding the overlap credit: we can offer a one-month pro-rata credit against the upcoming invoice if the overlap period is documented in the SOW amendment — we’ll include that language in the draft.

Owner assignments on our side: I’ll be primary for delivery and evidence coordination; I’m copying Sales Ops for PO handling.

We’ll attach the SOW draft and the initial evidence checklist in a follow-up.

Best,
Sarah Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive
Okta, Inc.
S: +1 617-555-8822

Attachments referenced: sow-amendment-draft.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@okta.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Okta subscription sunset, migration & evidence sprint

Stephanie / team —

Good to hear Okta can meet the dates. Internal notes / owners: 

- Evidence artifacts: I’ll own controls intake (inventory + test evidence) and will use the attached redwood-evidence-index.xlsx. I’ll run a 30-min pre-sprint sync on Sep 12 to align on folders and expected filenames.
- Legal review: Karthik, can you get Legal to prioritize the SOW amendment review once we get the draft on Sep 8? We should aim to have comments back by Sep 11 so there’s time for a redline pass.
- Platform/engineering: Vivek, we need the device-posture signal spec (macOS disk encryption, Intune/MDM enrollment state, screen-lock status, last boot time, VPN presence). Can you confirm by Sep 9 so Okta can reference it in the SOW?

I’m also starting a short risk log — biggest item is PO timing vs price-band. If Finance can commit to PO issuance by Sep 26 we’ll be good; otherwise we need an exec-level approval to accept the ~7% delta.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-evidence-index.xlsx

Thanks — Finance notes: we can aim to issue the PO by Sep 26 but need final SOW with exact billing lines by Sep 18 to route for approvals. Two asks for Okta Sales Ops: please provide the billing-ready quote line items (SKU, qty, term, pro-rata rules) and the PO template you prefer (we use yours if simpler). I’ve attached our PO template as a reference (po-template.xlsx).

Can we do a 20-min call on Sep 11 to align approvals path and sign-off owners?

Karthik Iyer
Head of Finance Operations

Folks —

Confirming next steps from our side:

1) We uploaded the SOW amendment draft and the evidence checklist to the shared folder (SOW note: includes adaptive auth scope and the device-posture signal list). Expect the SOW PDF by end of day; legal comments to follow.
2) Evidence sprint calendar invites: Sep 16 09:00–10:30 PDT, Sep 17 09:00–10:30 PDT, Sep 18 09:00–10:30 PDT (invites sent).
3) PO / pricing: we confirm that a PO dated by Sep 26 will lock the current pricing band. If Finance needs it earlier for approvals we can accept scanned PO placeholder and follow-up with the formal PO within five business days.

Credit: we will include a one-month pro-rata credit line in the SOW amendment to cover any documented overlap (internal billing will require the PO + overlap note).

If you’re good with the plan, we’ll proceed with SOW redline and evidence sessions.

Thanks,
Sarah Bennett
